REQ-001.design_rationale: Section 1 and Section 3 (Step 2) of design.md specify the in-place shape update of arm10 (ocid1.instance.oc1.ap-tokyo-1.anxhiljrnfuvvryc6oko53rm4ye7fjpo5xv7qybcbmm6p5pzjie66xtnqsna) to ocpus=4 and memoryInGBs=24 via oci compute instance update with --wait-for-state RUNNING, followed by post-reboot SSH checks for 4 vCPUs in lscpu, ~22-23 GiB RAM in free -h, and K3s Ready status.
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 2 in tasks.md defines the exact oci compute instance update command for arm10 and falsifiable post-reboot verification checks (lscpu, free -h, and k3s kubectl get nodes).
REQ-001.debate_rationale: ADR-0046 in decisions.md justifies vertical scaling of arm10 in-place to 4 OCPUs / 24 GB RAM, documents the ~60-90s reboot trade-off, and rejects splitting across two 2-OCPU / 12-GB A1 instances because an extra 47 GB boot volume would push total boot storage to 241 GB (>200 GB Always Free block storage limit).

REQ-002.design_rationale: Section 1, Section 2 (Step 1), and Section 3 of design.md specify creating the root tenancy quota policy always-free-payg-guardrail before scaling arm10 to lock standard-a1-core-count to 4, standard-a1-memory-count to 24, and total-storage-gb to 200 GB, plus post-scale verification and tightening via oci limits resource-availability get so available = 0.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 1 and Task 2 in tasks.md provide actionable steps to create always-free-payg-guardrail via oci limits quota create prior to resizing arm10, verify effective-quota-value, and tighten quota statements post-resize if used=3/18 so available=0.
REQ-002.debate_rationale: ADR-0046 in decisions.md establishes locking root compartment quotas prior to compute scaling, evaluates the hard QuotaExceeded admission ceiling trade-off, and rejects relying solely on asynchronous billing budget alerts that fire only after billable resources are provisioned.

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 4 (Step 3) of design.md defines the HCL updates in compute.tf for oci_core_instance.arm10.shape_config (ocpus = 4, memory_in_gbs = 24) and the new oci_limits_quota.always_free_guardrail resource, followed by terraform import and terraform validate.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 3 in tasks.md specifies updating compute.tf with oci_limits_quota.always_free_guardrail and arm10 shape_config (4 OCPUs / 24 GB RAM), importing the quota OCID into terraform.tfstate, and running rtk terraform validate.
REQ-003.debate_rationale: ADR-0046 Decision 3 aligns with the repository's Terraform-First Infrastructure Policy by codifying both the instance shape and root compartment quota in compute.tf and synchronizing state.

REQ-004.design_rationale: Section 5 (Step 4) of design.md specifies authoring docs/adr/0046-scale-arm10-4ocpu-24gb-and-lock-payg-quotas.md and updating docs/README.md to register ADR-0046 and the 4 OCPUs / 24 GB RAM arm10 hardware invariant.
REQ-004.tasks_rationale: Task 4 in tasks.md explicitly requires authoring docs/adr/0046-scale-arm10-4ocpu-24gb-and-lock-payg-quotas.md, registering it in docs/README.md, and recording verbatim verification outputs in verification.md.
REQ-004.debate_rationale: ADR-0046 in decisions.md follows structured Nygard and anti-dogma requirements with Context, Decision, Trade-offs & Risks, and Rejected Alternatives.
